title: AIESC 2027 decision-reliability update v1: fixed review budgets and risk-stratum reliability
status: Post hoc exploratory analysis requested after the main and follow-up results were known; this file was written before any of its numbers were computed. No model is trained; only saved out-of-fold scores are re-analysed.
event: actual term grade < 60 (population A, n = 83,494; zero grades excluded)

configurations.original_oof: Saved out-of-fold predictions of the IR study (models fitted on the full training folds): LightGBM, CatBoost, FT-Transformer, NGBoost (point), LightGBM-L1, plus NGBoost P(Y < 60) from the same NGBoost fit.
configurations.refit_80: Models refitted on 80% of the students of each training fold (follow-ups 1 and 2; same partition): LightGBM-L2, LightGBM-L1, LightGBM classifier, LightGBM q = 0.25, class-weighted LightGBM-L2, NGBoost. Never pooled or ranked together with original_oof.

scores.ranking_scores: negative predicted grade (regressions, quantile model, NGBoost point): orders records only, not a probability
scores.probability_scores: NGBoost P(Y < 60) = Phi((60 - mu) / sigma) (raw); LightGBM classifier output (raw); isotonic / Platt versions fitted on the 20% calibration students (refit_80 only). Ranking uses the raw score; recalibration changes probability levels only.

budget_analysis.rule: within each test fold, flag exactly the share x of the fold's records with the highest risk score; records tied at the cut-off are included fractionally (expected value under random tie-breaking); counts are pooled over the five folds
metrics: records reviewed per low-grade record found = 1 / precision

contrasts.original_oof: recall at each budget, each score minus LightGBM (5 scores x 5 budgets = 25), Holm within the family
contrasts.refit_80: recall at each budget, each score minus refitted LightGBM-L2 (5 x 5 = 25), Holm within its own family
contrasts.note: precision differences at a fixed budget are proportional to recall differences in every replicate and are reported without separate tests

risk_strata.rule: within each test fold, records are ranked by the score using mid-ranks for ties; a tie block is never split, so realised stratum shares are reported
risk_strata.ranking_reliability: observed low-grade rate, lift, mean predicted grade, mean actual grade (all scores)
risk_strata.probability_calibration: mean predicted probability, calibration gap (mean predicted - observed), Brier score (probability scores only)
risk_strata.interval_coverage: 90% intervals; original_oof: NGBoost raw, rescaled and the three cross-fold conformal variants, strata by original NGBoost P(Y < 60); refit_80: the eight follow-up-1 methods, strata by refitted NGBoost P(Y < 60) for NGBoost-based intervals and by refitted LightGBM-L2 for LightGBM-based intervals (CQR, split conformal around LightGBM)
risk_strata.comparisons: descriptive 95% CIs; top-5% stratum minus all records (coverage) and isotonic / Platt minus raw (calibration gap) as paired bootstrap differences without hypothesis tests
